name: calimia-order-desk
description: Calimia Home Order Desk: one board for web, POS and draft-order sales from quote to delivery, kept in sync with the Shopify Web Orders Asana project, with late-order alerts, Gmail drafts and guards on order-changing actions.

shopifyServer.title: Shopify MCP server
shopifyServer.description: The Shopify connector's name as /mcp lists it.

asanaServer.title: Asana MCP server
asanaServer.description: The Asana connector's name as /mcp lists it.

gmailServer.title: Gmail MCP server
gmailServer.description: The Gmail connector's name as /mcp lists it.

adminStore.title: Shopify admin store handle
adminStore.description: The part after /store/ in your Shopify admin URL.

assignee.title: Default assignee
assignee.description: Email of the person new order tasks are assigned to.

shipSlaDays.title: Ship within (business days)
shipSlaDays.description: A paid order not shipped or in production after this many business days is late.

invoiceReminderDays.title: Invoice reminder after (days)
invoiceReminderDays.description: A sent draft-order invoice unpaid this long is flagged.

pickupReminderDays.title: Pickup reminder after (days)
pickupReminderDays.description: An order ready for pickup this long is flagged.

syncMinutes.title: Minutes between syncs
syncMinutes.description: How often the open session syncs Shopify and Asana (5 or more).

lookbackDays.title: Days of orders to watch
lookbackDays.description: Orders from this many days back, plus every unfulfilled order.

createTasks.title: Create Asana tasks
createTasks.description: Create tasks for new paid orders, and for sent quotes when the project has a Quotes section.

autoSync.title: Update Asana automatically
autoSync.description: Off: the board lists the updates for you to apply.

guards.title: Ask before order-changing actions
guards.description: Ask before Claude marks a draft paid, cancels, refunds or fulfills an order, or sends an email.
